task_instance: Create a folder-scoped CLAUDE.md with Purpose/Essential Files/Constraints/Conventions/Locked Decisions sections for a sample 'payments-service' folder, derived only from its files, plus an AGENTS.md symlink pointing at it.
evidence: Built a realistic sample folder payments-service/ with package.json, src/server.ts, DECISIONS.md, README.md. Read each file in full. Wrote payments-service/CLAUDE.md with a one-line purpose header and ## sections (Product/Purpose, Essential Files, Constraints MUST NOT, Conventions, Locked Decisions); every bullet traces to the sample files (integer-cents rule and idempotency key from server.ts; synchronous settlement, cents-only, manual refunds from DECISIONS.md; port 8082 and active status from README). Created the AGENTS.md symlink via 'ln -s CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md'. Verified with 'ls -la CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md' (AGENTS.md -> CLAUDE.md), 'readlink AGENTS.md' returned CLAUDE.md, and 'head -1 AGENTS.md' resolved through the symlink to the CLAUDE.md header line. The skill's optional background reference library file is noted in SKILL.md as not bundled and is not required for the core deliverable. No bundled script, model, or external service was needed; no connector/MCP tools used.
